## Attendance

The January 2021 programme board meeting was chaired by J. Whitfield. Attendees were J. Whitfield, S. Rahman, Priya Anand, R. Adeyemi, L. Petrov. The board confirmed that the meeting record would reflect the attendance and the matters discussed.

## Performance

The board reviewed activity and operational performance for January 2021. The programme recorded 1315 captures during the period. The outstanding grader backlog was 110. Letter breaches remained at 0. Members noted the current position and agreed that performance should continue to be monitored through the programme’s regular reporting arrangements.

## Items

The board considered CHG-0114 SMS invitations go live. The item was noted, with an update to be provided at a subsequent meeting. Members discussed the importance of maintaining oversight of implementation and ensuring that any emerging issues are reported through the appropriate programme arrangements.

## Actions

The owner is to report back on CHG-0114 SMS invitations go live. The board will continue to review capture activity, the grader backlog and letter breaches at future meetings. Actions carried forward to the next meeting.
